// diagnostic

E0224

This call writes or takes the named place it is called on, but the place has no mark.

What

This call writes or takes the named place it is called on, but the place has no mark.

Why

A method declared with `&self` writes its receiver and one declared with `^self` takes it; the mark shows that permission on the named place, the same way `edit(&buf)` and `consume(^text)` mark arguments.

Fix

Write `&` before the place for a writing call (`&buf.append(x)`) or `^` for a taking call (`^buf.seal()`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0224: tests/ui/ownership/builtin_and_composite_receivers_use_the_call_access_frame.stderr.

Error [jet.UseWhileWriteActive]: `values` is being changed in this call, so it can't be used again here
  --> builtin_and_composite_receivers_use_the_call_access_frame.jet:4:30
    |
  4 |     &values.insert(0, values.remove(0, .Slot))
    |                              ^^^^^^
 Why: While something is being changed through the write-access marker `&`, nobody else may be looking at it
 Fix: Pass the write-access marker `&` (`&values`) only once, or copy first with `values.copy()`

 Why: The method is declared with `&self`, so the call writes the named place it is called on; the mark sits on that place, the same way `edit(&buf)` and `consume(^text)` mark arguments
 Fix: Write `&values`
